notes: Transition styles are now scoped beneath .chapter-transition. The Level 1 header at 1366px changed from 163px with a hidden title and 56px title font to 71px with a visible 31px title. All three compact workbench headings are checked at 1366/768/390/320px; existing chapter transitions retain their sequence, mute, reduced-motion and visible-time behaviour.

The redundant Level 3 effort-prediction page, stored predictions and prediction/result markers were removed. Confirmed weights and explicit references run directly into publication; comparison preserves both actual player attempts and any actual reference run. Level 1 retains its original prediction.

The positive-weight rule remains 1% minimum and 100% total, with endpoints 98/1/1 and 61/38/1. All valid positive integer triples, linked confirmation orders and the inclusive ten-point near-even boundary pass their rule checks.

The newly invented peer-passing-card story, visual panel, narrative module and peerInteraction request field are withdrawn. The original simple Level 2 placeholder/dialogue and six-field request schema are restored. Existing user-authored formal scripts and animation files were not edited. A supplied renderCinematic replaces the whole placeholder without a duplicated panel or appended social story.

The completed 10- and 25-metric illustrated actions each hold approximately 3.5 visible seconds; timing is measured from their completed DOM state, excluding hidden intervals. Scrolling and assertions consume time and are not used as the start of the hold. The continuous 10/25/100 sequence preserves satisfaction checkpoints 70/77/82/86, hidden-page pauses and the final explicit Observe action at 100.

All five latest ZIPs pass integrity and hash checks, with HTML identical to the production builds. The review ZIP contains both standalone Level 3 and connected Levels 1–3 from those same builds. Packaged offline flows, partner replacement, player-name transfer, editable imported priorities, mute and the theory-placeholder endpoint are verified.
The original v12 source and downloads remain frozen on archive/pre-feedback-cleanup-v12 at 031bbb0a737990294258ae97c86ad1badb43b5af. Earlier archive branches and versioned ZIPs are unchanged.
Opening-animation integration and the Level 1 opening handoff remain a separate next step. No Design Lab navigation or new authored animation script was added.

Functional checks do not establish measured learning effectiveness. Offline checks use exact production/packaged HTML on an in-memory HTTPS origin; direct file opening in the user browser, classroom load capacity and finished video assets are not claimed as tested. Earlier broader suites remain historical in their versioned reports and were not rerun in full.
